**D2 PR3 judgment-day R3: CONFIRMED CRITICAL — revert-of-revert laundering bypass (resolution reasons pairwise, never checks NET tip effect)**

**What**: Judgment-day (2 blind judges, opus, both forged end-to-end via the real CLI) on D2 PR3 wiring (brain-audit.mjs) found a CONFIRMED CRITICAL: a revert-of-a-reverter re-introduces an ungoverned artifact while the audit goes fully GREEN (all [SKIP], exit 0), cursor advances — the exact "wrong skip masks an offender forever" catastrophe D2 exists to prevent.

**Shape (forged by Judge B, cleanest)**: O = adrPresence offender (ADR w/o HOME.md, valid issue ref); R = `git revert -m1 O` (legit); R2 = `git revert -m1 R` (= re-adds O's exact payload). Audit output: R2 `[SKIP] revert of R`, R `[SKIP] resolved by revert`, O `[SKIP] resolved by revert`, exit 0 — ungoverned ADR sits on disk at HEAD, nothing red. Judge A forged the equivalent M1→Rev→X(re-add) shape and showed the cron backstop range `last-tag..HEAD` (governance-postmerge.yml) is exactly what triggers it.

**Root cause (Judge B named it)**: `isResolvedAt(O, tip)` in resolution.mjs (PR2 predicate, ALREADY MERGED to feature/v2.0.0) returns resolved iff SOME first-parent merge in (O, tip] inverts O's contribution — it NEVER checks the inversion is NET at the tip. Combined with reverterSkipLine crowning R2 as "revert of R" (R2 is the tree-exact inverse of R, and R itself IS an offender because reverting an ADR-add also trips adrPresence → isOffender(R)=true → gate passes → adrPresence subtracted as tree-keyed). The whole safety property "re-introduction after revert is not resolved" (REQ-D2-10, A5) holds ONLY for FRESH-merge re-adds (all A5 tests it) and is DEFEATED by revert-structured re-adds. No test builds a double-`git revert` shape (A6 stops at O→R).

**Also confirmed (both judges, WARNING real)**: `[FAIL-SHA]` emission is class-blind (brain-audit.mjs:496, parse-failures.mjs sha-only) — emits a revert signal for memoryPresence/issueLink failures, which REQ-D2-10a says are re-eval/human-gate classes NEVER resolved by tree-effect. Latent today (shipped governance-postmerge.yml reverts github.sha, doesn't consume [FAIL-SHA] yet — PR4), but the emission defect is in-scope now: a single repo-global memoryPresence gap marks EVERY innocent merge for auto-revert; a partial-reverter-skip emits [FAIL-SHA] for a legit reverter R whose auto-revert resurrects O.

**Suggestions**: (SUGG, both) adrPresence [FAIL] reason gives no remediation (human-gate `cursor accept --reason`). (SUGG, Judge B only, suspect) isOffender gate is provably inert dead-code — the comment's keep-justification ("two DIFFERENT merges sharing a byte-exact tree-inverse of same R, one non-offending one offending") describes an UNREACHABLE state (both share identical tree → identical tree-keyed verdicts; they can only differ on issueLink/memoryPresence which are excluded from the mirrored set anyway).

**Clean (forged)**: J3-2 (R's non-tree-keyed own violations surface as [FAIL]), J3-3 (crossCheck count-only but wrong-sha unconstructible today — honest FIX2 defense-in-depth).

**Why**: Owner brief demanded forge-not-reason judgment. Both judges independently converged → confirmed.

**Where**: brain/scripts/brain-audit.mjs (reverterSkipLine 145-168, resolvedSkipLine 43-46, [FAIL-SHA] emit 496), brain/scripts/governance/postmerge/resolution.mjs (isResolvedAt — PR2, merged). Fixtures under scratchpad/j32-revchain, a5-readd.

**Next**: NOT approved. CRITICAL likely needs back-to-DESIGN (net-tip-effect anchor) since it implicates the merged PR2 predicate, not just PR3 wiring — echoes PR2-R1 precedent. Owner ruling required before any fix agent. Not committed.
